uncited: **Render Depth Map:** For each pixel, identify the Gaussian $G_{i_{max}}$ with the maximum contribution $w_i$.
Calculate the mid-point depth $d_{mid}$ of this Gaussian using the ellipsoid intersection method.
**Reproject to World Space:** Convert the 2D depth map values $d_{mid}$ back into 3D world coordinates using the camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters.
**Sample Initial Points:** Randomly select a subset of these reprojected points.
*   **Time Complexity:** The method adds overhead during the optimization loop for rendering depth maps and reprojecting points.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Requires storing the depth map and the sampled point cloud (3.5M points).
